%function(self) self:x(SCREEN_CENTER_X) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y) self:addx(300) self:linear(0.25) self:addx(-300) if Profile().IIDXGoldScreenFilter then self:diffusealpha(tonumber(Profile().IIDXGoldScreenFilter)) else self:diffusealpha(0.3) end end
